claims: AI Players identify 24 of 24 sampled ranks, 8 of 8 king-or-queen roles, and 24 of 24 neutral-material sides in the exact recognition renders.

Agent Playtest fails because 64 exact square-center samples in the native-material top acceptance render all have red-channel value 29 (minimum 29, maximum 29, population standard deviation 0.0), leaving alternating board parity and the playable 8 by 8 field unreadable without outside convention.

Agent Playtest also fails because the raw border views do not make the Manhattan street perimeter or one isolated Broadway diagonal unmistakable; diagnostic depth edges are expressly ineligible and cannot rescue either blocker.
limitations: The scores are deterministic AI Player observations over exact-CAD images, not an independent human recognition or enjoyment study.
No physical board, tactile contrast, lighting variation, finish, handling, durability, or customer experience was tested.
simulation: Six AI Player roles reviewed exact native-material, neutral-recognition, and NYC-form renders under the immutable Round 3 configuration
